title: Sparkly cherries
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cherryGrad' cx='35%' cy='30%'>

      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e01e4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a80f30'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cherryGrad2' cx='35%' cy='30%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7ba0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e8285a'/>

  <path d='M44 52 Q46 32 52 22' stroke='#7bc47f' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 54 Q60 34 54 22' stroke='#6bb870' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M54 22 Q66 14 76 20 Q68 30 54 26 Z' fill='#5fce6b'/>

    <path d='M78 82 l2 6 l6 2 l-6 2 l-2 6 l-2 -6 l-6 -2 l6 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M18 80 l1.5 4.5 l4.5 1.5 l-4.5 1.5 l-1.5 4.5 l-1.5 -4.5 l-4.5 -1.5 l4.5 -1.5 z'/>
